long_biography.plain_text:
In San Remo, Bertil Karlsson found a neglected three-masted schooner and decided to bring it home to Orust. After a substantial refit, he and his family developed a commercial programme of charters, weddings and conferences around the restored sailing vessel. The operation lasted until its sale in 2010.

The collapse of Najad-Nordwest opened another project. Karlsson and former Najad service manager Claes Samuelsson established a Henån yard offering winter storage, maintenance and insurance repairs for sailing and motor boats. The venture built on Orust's established boatbuilding skills, grew into a sizeable service operation and added a motorhome campsite to the property before passing to new ownership.
